gaps.sentence: The rebels finally ___ down the government.
gaps.explanation: 'Bring down a government' = cause its collapse.

gaps.sentence: The kids made ___ a story about a stolen dog.
gaps.explanation: make up = invent (a story, excuse). Compare make up for = compensate.

gaps.sentence: He puts his success down ___ hard work and a bit of luck.
gaps.explanation: put something down TO something = believe it has that cause.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
The plane takes ___ in ten minutes.
gaps.explanation: take off = leave the ground (plane); also remove clothes; become successful (career took off).
